meta.name: qodo-pr-resolver
meta.description: Review and resolve PR issues with Qodo - get AI-powered code review issues and fix them interactively (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查并交互式修复代码审查问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查PR并修复代码问题
copy.tagline_en: Review and fix code review issues interactively
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often review PRs and fix code issues

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会拉取当前分支 PR 的 Qodo 审查意见,按严重程度列表展示;按你的选择逐个或批量修复问题(照 Qodo 提供的修复指引改代码),回复每条行内评论,并提交、推送代码,在 PR 上发布处理总结。
howto.when: 当你说“qodo review”“resolve pr”“show qodo”等关键词,或要求查看/修复 Qodo 的 PR 审查意见时触发;前提是当前分支有被 Qodo 审查过的开放 PR。

say.text: 帮我看看 Qodo 对当前 PR 的审查意见
say.note: Claude 会拉取并展示问题列表和严重程度。

say.text: 自动修复这个 PR 的所有 Qodo 问题
say.note: Claude 进入批量修复模式,提交后推送代码。

say.text: resolve pr,逐条处理并回复行内评论
say.note: Claude 逐个展示修复方案,经你确认后应用。

howto.what_en: Claude fetches Qodo review issues for the current PR, ranks them by severity, fixes them interactively or in batch per Qodo's fix prompts, replies to each inline comment, commits and pushes, then posts a PR summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says keywords like 'qodo review', 'resolve pr', or 'show qodo', or asks to view/fix Qodo PR review issues. Requires a git repo with an open PR already reviewed by Qodo.

say_en.text: Show me Qodo's review issues for the current PR.
say_en.note: Claude fetches and lists issues with severity.

say_en.text: Auto-fix all Qodo issues on this PR.
say_en.note: Claude applies fixes in batch, then commits and pushes.

say_en.text: Resolve PR issues one by one and reply to comments.
say_en.note: Claude shows each fix and waits for your approval.
